question: Train A leaves station M at 7:20 a.m. and reaches station N at 3:20 p.m. on the same day. Train B leaves station N at 9:20 a.m. and reaches station M at 4:20 p.m. on the same day. Find the time when Trains A and B meet.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time taken by Train A = 8 hrs and Train B = 7 hrs. Let distance = 56 km (LCM of 8, 7).

Speed of Train A = 7 km/h, Speed of Train B = 8 km/h. Relative speed = 7 + 8 = 15 km/h.

Train A travels for 2 hrs (7:20 a.m. to 9:20 a.m.) covering 14 km.

Remaining distance = 56 − 14 = 42 km.

Time to meet = 42 ÷ 15 = 2.8 hrs = 2 hrs 48 mins.

Meeting time = 9:20 a.m. + 2 hrs 48 mins = 12:08 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 12:08 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Train A starts at 7:20 a.m. and arrives at 3:20 p.m.

Train B starts at 9:20 a.m. and arrives at 4:20 p.m.

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Time to meet = Distance between them ÷ Relative Speed
